raw_html: [[Eternal Holy Burst#Eternal Holy Burst|Eternal Holy Burst]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Eternal Holy Burst#Eternal Holy Burst|Eternal Holy Burst]]:''' While you are wearing this item, your melee, ranged, and unarmed attacks gain the Holy Burst ability. (This weapon is holy. The weapon deals an additional 1 to 6 good damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 good damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.)
